freeze: decisions.md §13.1 (P0c timing, P0d record): the commit of this file freezes docs/d28/hypotheses.md before any label generation, the landscape and budget pilots included. Approved by Devansh 17 Nov 2026 (OQ-P8-1 option (a)). The git commit timestamp is authoritative.

hypotheses.note: local file (never committed); any later change is a dated amendment outside it

test_cohort_sizes.rule: fixed size per test cohort and size = ceil(200 / r), r the pilot cell's solvable rate (expected solvable 200) (frozen proposal of decisions.md §18 P6d item 4); d28_test_cve uses the cve_all cell

training.rule: cap per size = smallest N with P(Binomial(N, r_low) >= 231) >= 0.999, r_low the size's Wilson 95% lower bound; 231 per size x 13 sizes = 3,003 (OQ-P7d-1); frozen with the all-sizes guarantee (P(shortfall) <= 0.001 / 13 per size, union bound over the 13 sizes), decided 17 Nov 2026 by Devansh

validation.rule: same rule with quota 31 per size x 13 sizes = 403 (OQ-P7d-1); validation draws the training cell under its own seeds (d28.val); frozen with the all-sizes guarantee (P(shortfall) <= 0.001 / 13 per size, union bound over the 13 sizes), decided 17 Nov 2026 by Devansh

state_budget.rule: OQ-P7-8 (accepted 17 Nov 2026, decisions.md §19): the smallest candidate budget under which at least `target` of the sampled training states certify (A*+LM-cut within the budget) in both regimes; it also applies to s0 (OQ-P7-7)
state_budget.sample: the budget pilot's stratified sample of the frozen training cohort (every training size)
state_budget.value_from: filled mechanically from the budget pilot run into configs/labels/d28.json state_budget; no choice is made; if no candidate meets the target the value stays null and the item is BLOCKED (Round 9)
